answer: To achieve Sybil resistance, an economy of AI agents employs staked cryptographic attestations paired with hardware enclave telemetry. Dispersing the fable of costless identity, the network forces nodes to lock collateral at a protocol jetty before issuing non-transferable validation tokens. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake nodes must continuously burn capital across each isolated, ivory enclave, turning large-scale identity spoofing into an exponentially unviable economic drain.
